name: 1.11.3-1.21.1 - NeoForge
changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fix frustumculling not using whitelist, Fix frustum-culling using the uninflated hitbox. Fix [#341](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/341). This should fix any weird pop-in/outs happening when just turning the camera
- Make the entity reference weak to prevent leaks caused by Fabric API. Fix [#6](https://github.com/tr7zw/TRansition/issues/6) . Over multiple corners, TRansition(one of my libs) with FabricAPI caused a leak of the entire level when leaving a world, wasting memory. 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/compare/1.11.2...1.11.3
